ns2:section.sectionText: Priority registration is restricted to Statistics graduate students, and undergraduate students majoring in Statistics or Statistics & Computer Science. This restriction is expected to be removed sometime during the business day December 1, 2015. This course is set below capacity to hold space for incoming Statistics graduate students. If you are one of those students, please speak to your advisor. Capacity may fluctuate. If the remaining seats are at 0 or negative, you will not be able to register.
